correctness.rationale: For s=1-G down to0, s[s^{-(1-s)}-1]=exp(s log s)-s ->1, hence A=[s^{-(1-s)}-1]^alpha ~s^-alpha. In exact generator -log S=lambda A+lambda log(lambda+(1-lambda)e^-A), second term is bounded, so -logS~lambda s^-alpha. Burr XII s=(1+x^beta)^-k yields exponent delta=alpha beta k and full strict exponential-comparison trichotomy at delta=1. Tail integrals yield power and off-boundary exponential moments, monotone inversion gives extreme quantile. Weibull baseline gives superexponential double-log scale. Independently tested several normalized exact survival ratios at x=10^7.
